# Third-party components

## TrackEval

`TrackEval/` is included as an evaluation dependency/framework.

It is developed by the TrackEval authors and retains its upstream license and attribution. The repository does not include the large benchmark datasets or generated tracker outputs that were present in the original working directory.

See:

```text
third_party/TrackEval/LICENSE
third_party/TrackEval/Readme.md
```
